name: Cryptocurrency Protocol Engineer
description: Implement layer-1 and layer-2 blockchain protocols. Build consensus mechanisms, mempool management, and P2P networking stacks.
example_snippet:
program Mempool:
    shape Transaction holds:
        Nonce as whole number
        GasPrice as whole number
        GasLimit as whole number
        To as text
        Value as whole number
        Data as text
        Hash as text
    end shape
    
    action validate_tx takes Tx as const ref Transaction produces truth value:
        if Tx.GasLimit is less than 21000 then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        if Tx.GasPrice is equal to 0 then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        produce success with true
    end action
    
    keep Tx1 as Transaction with 0 and 20000000000 and 21000 and "0xabc" and 1000000000000000000 and "" and "0xhash"
    keep Valid as truth value
    call validate_tx with Tx1 giving Valid
    print the text "Transaction valid: " and Valid and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active (C++17/20/23, CI-tested). dictum_net.c (P2P sockets), dictum_tls.c (secure comms), dictum_json.c (tx serialization). Crypto hashing requires C import OpenSSL.
